title: 第5章 不愧是最毒妇人心第6章 纯阳之体奇迹也会眷顾苦命之人
content_zh:
昨夜，林陌在来之前，就已经抱着必死的决心了。
再加上对柳紫嫣的了解，因此林陌并不对柳紫嫣这女魔头抱有任何的奢望。
就算柳紫嫣不杀自己，林陌也没多少时日可活了。
再加上，有了昨晚与柳紫嫣那难忘的一夜，林陌穿越过来一趟，已经死而无憾。
“老贱种，玷污了本宫，真以为自己可以如此轻易获得解脱？”
柳紫嫣冰冷的眸子微眨，冷声道。
虽然很不想承认，但不知为何，柳紫嫣竟觉得此刻的林陌，看上去似乎不是那么的不顺眼了。
她昨夜明明还发誓要将林陌碎尸万段来着。
回想起昨夜那段经历，柳紫嫣就恨不得当场手刃了林陌。
林陌不过是初圣宗的一介杂役，地位连狗都不如，而她呢？
是实力强大，地位尊贵的初圣宗掌门！
她被林陌趁虚玷污的事若是传出去，她的名声和形象肯定是毁了。
可偏偏...
昨晚的一夜激情，让她食髓知味了。
林陌明明是一个半截身子入土的人了，却还有如此威猛的爆发力，也许是他积攒了百年都未曾释放的原因？
本来她是瞧不起世上所有男修的，宁愿自娱自乐，也绝不愿让肮脏的狗男人玷污自己的身体。
但无论如何，林陌也确实让她认识到了，男人带来的快乐，远不是她的中指可以比拟的。
更重要的是。
卡了她几十年的桎梏，就如她那坚守了数百年的贞洁一般，被一夜之间捅破。
彻底打破化神期圆满的瓶颈，迈入了炼虚期的境界！

这，才是柳紫嫣昨夜最大的收获。
若没有昨晚林陌临死前的僭越，她这辈子大抵也不会知道，阴阳调和对于阴阳邪魔功的重要性和必要性。
她想要突破化神期的瓶颈，晋入炼虚期，也许还需要再花费一两百年的时间。
她更加不会知道，男人才是女人最大的补品。
这也是为什么，人类会有男女两种性别的原因。
但如果要论柳紫嫣犹豫究竟杀不杀林陌的主要原因，还是阴阳邪魔功。
阴阳邪魔功是由远古时期的一位邪修大能和他的道侣所创造。
其道侣为了避免自己的夫君在外面拈花惹草，于是将阴阳邪魔功改造了一番，使得阴阳邪魔功只认第一次所吸收的阳气或是阴气。
也就是说，如果要继续修阴阳邪魔功，柳紫嫣只能通过和林陌阴阳调和来提升自己的修为。
但凡换一个男人都不会有任何的效果。
但...林陌这一副糟老头子的模样，又着实让她感到有些埋汰。
至于林陌命不久矣的问题，对林陌来说或许是问题，但对她来说则完全不是问题。
一枚续命丹即可让林陌延长个三五年寿命。
但三五年时间，对她这个修为的人来说，又能够做什么呢？
最终还是得让林陌自己去提升修为，从而增加自己的寿命才行。
“为了修炼，本宫倒也不是不可以给这贱种一次机会...若他胆敢再僭越本宫，即使拼着高成本转修其他功法，本宫也定要将他扒皮抽筋！”
心中如此想着之时。
content_en:
Last night, before Lin Mo came, he was already determined to die.
Coupled with his understanding of Liu Ziyan, Lin Mo did not have any extravagant hopes for Liu Ziyan, the female devil.
Even if Liu Ziyan didn't kill herself, Lin Mo wouldn't have much time left to live.
In addition, after the unforgettable night with Liu Ziyan last night, Lin Mo traveled through time and died without regrets.
"Old bitch, you have defiled this palace. Do you really think you can be freed so easily?"
Liu Ziyan blinked her cold eyes slightly and said coldly.
Although she didn't want to admit it, for some reason, Liu Ziyan felt that Lin Mo didn't look so unpleasant at this moment.
She clearly vowed last night that she would cut Lin Mo into pieces.
Recalling the experience last night, Liu Ziyan wished she could kill Lin Mo on the spot.
Lin Mo was just a handyman of Chu Sheng Sect, his status was not even as good as that of a dog, but what about her?
He is the leader of the First Holy Sect with powerful strength and distinguished status!
If word spreads that she was defiled by Lin Mo, her reputation and image will definitely be ruined.
But unfortunately...
The night of passion last night made her taste the essence.
Lin Mo was obviously half buried in the ground, but he still had such powerful explosive power. Maybe it was the reason why he had accumulated it for hundreds of years and never released it?
Originally, she looked down on all the male cultivators in the world, and would rather entertain herself than let dirty dog ​​men defile her body.
But no matter what, Lin Mo did make her realize that the happiness a man brings is far beyond what her middle finger can compare with.
What's more.
The shackles that had held her captive for decades were broken overnight, just like her chastity that she had maintained for hundreds of years.
Completely breaking the bottleneck of completing the Divine Transformation Stage and entering the realm of Void Refining Stage!
This was Liu Ziyan's biggest gain last night.
If Lin Mo hadn't transgressed before her death last night, she would probably never know the importance and necessity of the harmony of yin and yang in the yin and yang evil skills.
If she wants to break through the bottleneck of the Divine Transformation Stage and advance to the Void Refining Stage, it may take another hundred or two hundred years.
She doesn't even know that men are women's greatest supplements.
This is also the reason why humans have two genders: male and female.
But if we want to talk about the main reason why Liu Ziyan hesitates to kill Lin Mo, it is the Yin and Yang Demonic Skill.
The yin and yang evil skills were created by a great evil cultivator and his Taoist companions in ancient times.
In order to prevent her husband from flirting with women outside, her Taoist couple modified the Yin-Yang Demonic Art so that the Yin-Yang Demonic Art only recognizes the yang or yin energy absorbed for the first time.
In other words, if she wants to continue to practice the Yin and Yang Demonic Skills, Liu Ziyan can only improve her cultivation by harmonizing with Lin Mo's Yin and Yang.
Just changing to another man wouldn't have any effect.
But... Lin Mo's appearance as an old man really made her feel a little embarrassed.
As for the issue of Lin Mo's short life, it may be a problem for Lin Mo, but it is not a problem at all for her.
A life-extending pill can extend Lin Mo's life by three to five years.
But in three to five years, what can a person like her do?
In the end, he still had to let Lin Mo improve his cultivation to increase his lifespan.
"For the sake of cultivation, I can't give this bitch a chance... If he dares to overstep my bounds again, even if he pays a high cost to learn other techniques, I will definitely skin him and cramp him!"
When I think about it in my heart.
